headline: Approved minutes, bills, and over 30 contracts, change orders, wage increases, and donations totaling more than $1.5 million.
summary: The board approved the July 7, 2026 minutes and bills totaling $1,579,171.08 and $820,665.97. It approved numerous invoices, change orders, wage increases, a procurement delegation, insurance renewals up to $800,000, a $54,682.00 paving contract, policy adoptions, and several charitable donations.
decisions: Approved the July 7, 2026 meeting minutes.
Approved bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP, and Revolving Fund Register for July 2026.
Approved payment of $1,125.00 to Northeast Consultants LLC for the FY2027 Utility Allowance Schedule.
Approved payment of $10,899.14 to the YMCA for three invoices.
Approved a wage increase to $37.82 per hour for Karen Keenan.
Approved a wage increase to $32.97 per hour for Sonia Lee.
Approved payment of $18,713.35 to MVES for Resident Service Coordinators.
Approved a $17,659.40 change order from M.L. Schmitt for the Forestdale ModPhase project.
Approved and adopted the Section 8 and Public Housing Utility Tables for FY2027.
Approved payment of $3,375.00 to James M. Hennessey for informal hearings.
Approved payment of $4,258.56 to AVAYA Financial Services for contract termination and equipment purchase.
Approved two change orders totaling $14,096.71 from DEIULIS Brothers Construction for the Forestdale ModPhase project.
Approved delegation of procurement authority up to $10,000.00 to Randy Waters.
Approved two quotes from IUVO Technologies for Bridge Kits and Server Migration.
Approved payment of MHA insurance renewals for FY2027 up to $800,000.00.
Approved a $10.00 per hour price increase from KP Law, to $240.00 per hour.
Approved a $10,800.00 change order from Gordon/Griffin LLC increasing monthly contract cost to $9,900.00.
Approved payment of $23,964.82 to MRI Software for annual subscription and cloud fees.
Authorized Board Chair William P. Hurley to execute the EOHLC 2026-2027 DocuSign CFA Award Agreement.
Approved a change order up to $200,000.00 from M.L. Schmitt for transformer removal at Forestdale.
Approved purchase of furniture up to $50,000.00 for the Forestdale Community Room.
Approved an Application and Certificate for Payment of up to $71,358.31 to Southcoast Improvement Company.
Approved a $1,975.60 change order from Southcoast Improvement Company for electrical breakers.
Approved a $1,500.00 performance incentive award to Margherita Federico and Barbara Hooley.
Approved a task order up to $92,500.00 from MK Architecture LLC for the AMP 1 Linden Window and Siding Replacement Project Phase 2.
Approved low bid award and contract of $54,682.00 to Site Improvements, Inc. for Springdale Paving Reconstruction, rejecting two other bids.
Approved payment of $5,735.63 to the Malden Police Department for twelve invoices.
Approved adoption of MHA's FY2027 Affirmative Action Goal of 38.7%.
Approved and adopted the updated MHA State Public Housing Language Access Plan and Four Factor Analysis.
Approved a $250.00 donation to The Bread of Life.
Approved a $1,800.00 donation to support Malden Public Safety Day.
Approved purchase of a $125.00 full-page ad in the Mass Union of Public Housing Tenants Fall conference program book.
Approved a floral arrangement up to $150.00 and a $150.00 donation in recognition of former Commissioner Barbara Purcel's passing.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTED: To approve the 7-7-26 meeting minutes.
VOTED: To approve the bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and the Revolving Fund Register for July 2026
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $1,125.00 to Northeast Consultants LLC as detailed above with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount $10,899.14 to the YMCA as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve a wage increase to Karen Keenan for a new hourly rate of $37.82 per hour to as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve a wage increase to Sonia Lee in the amount of $32.97 per hour as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve payment of $18,713.35 to MVES as detailed above with cost paid by the AMP's served.
VOTED: To approve the change order in the amount of $17,659.40 from M.L. Schmitt as detailed above with cost paid by the State through CapHub.
VOTED: To Approve and Adopt the Section 8 and Public Housing Utility Tables for FY2027 to be implemented as of 1/1/2027.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $3,375.00 to James M. Hennessey as detailed above with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $4,258.56 from AVAYA Financial Services (First Citizens Bank & Trust Co.) as detailed above with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To approve two (2) change orders from DEIULIS as detailed above as part of the Forestdale ModPhase project with cost paid by the State through CapHub.
VOTED: To approve the delegation of procurement authority to Modernization and Procurement Director, Randy Waters, in the amount of up to $10,000.00 as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve two (2) quotes from IUVO technologies for Bridge Kits and Server Migration as detailed above.

VOTED: To approve payment of the renewal insurance policies for FY2027 FY2027 (10-1-26 to 9-30-27) in the amount up to $800,000.00 upon invoice receipt for each policy with cost as allocated by the Finance Director.

VOTED: To approve a price increase in the amount of $10.00 per hour (to $240.00 per hour) from KP Law for provision of legal services to MHA effective 9/1/2026 with cost to be paid by the cost center for which the services are rendered.
VOTED: To approve change order in the amount of $10,800.00 from Gordon/Griffin LLC for an additional fee of $900.00 per month...with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $23,964.82 from MRI as detailed above with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.
VOTED: To authorize Board Chair, William P. Hurley, to execute and submit EOHLC Docusign CFA Award Agreement.

VOTED: To approve a change order in the amount up to $200,000.00 from M.L. Schmitt for removal and responsible disposal of existing transformers at the Forestdale Load Replacement Center project with cost to be paid by the State through CapHub.
VOTED: To approve the purchase of furniture in the amount up to $50,000.00 to furnish the newly renovated Forestdale Community Room with cost paid by the COCC.
VOTED: To approve the Application and Certificate for Payment in the amount of up to $71,358.31 from Southcoast Improvement Company as detailed above with cost to be paid by the CFP.
VOTED: To approve change order in the amount of $1,975.60 from Southcoast Improvement Company as detailed above with cost paid by the CFP.

VOTED: To approve a performance incentive award in the amount of $1,500.00 to Finance Manager, Margherita Federico, and Executive Assistant, Barbara Hooley, as detailed above with cost to be paid by the COCC.

VOTED: To approve task order from MK Architecture LLC in the amount of up to $92,500.00 for design as detailed above for the AMP 1 Linden Window and Siding Replacement Project Phase 2 with cost paid by the CFP.

VOTED: To accept the recommendation of NE RCAT and approve low bid award and contract in the amount of $54,682.00 to Site Improvements, Inc. for MHA's Springdale Paving Reconstruction Project with cost to be paid by the State through CabHub.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $5,735.63 as detailed above to the Malden Police Department with cost paid by the AMP's served.
VOTED: To approve adoption of MHA's FY2027 Affirmative Action Goal of 38.7% for State Public Housing Program Administration.
VOTED: To approve and adopt updated MHA State Public Housing Language Access Plan and Four Factor Analysis for EOHLC CHAMP PMR submission.
VOTED: To approve donation in the amount of $250.00 to The Bread of Life with cost paid by the COCC.
VOTED: To approve donation in the amount of $1,800.00 to support Malden Public Safety Day with cost paid by the COCC.
VOTED: To approve the purchase of a full-page ad in the amount of $125.00 in Mass Union of Public Housing Tenants Fall conference program book.

VOTED: To approve the purchase of a floral arrangement in the amount up to $150.00 and donation of $150.00 to MHA's default charity in recognition of the passing of former Commissioner Barbara Purcel with cost paid by the COCC.
